messages:
jordan_support: FYI - LinguaAssist tenant 9842 reporting onboarding failures on translate pipeline; multiple customers stuck on step 3. They're past trial, renewal in 18 days. Raising to CS - urgent.

raj_support: repro attached - logs show 503 from inference: 'kv cache miss' on long inputs. Pasting snippet:
```
2026-03-20 15:02:11 ERROR translate_pipeline request_id=9842-7f status=503 kernel_timeout
```

emma_cs: Thanks Jordan - assigning to me. @chao_se can you triage model routing / quantization mismatch? Can we have a short comms plan by EOD? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

chao_se: looking now. Quick note: tenant is pinned to rdl-llama-7b-q4 (legacy). We saw edge-case with long prefix + batch size >8 causing OOM fallback -> 503. Short-term fix: set max_batch_size:4 and increase KV cache TTL. I'll open a canary with patch.

mika_pm: renewal risk flagged — need customer-facing comms + enablement call. Can we schedule 30-min session tomorrow? Prefer US mornings. Also capture feedback on doc gaps.

emma_cs: Draft comms: "We're investigating a performance regression affecting some translation jobs; short-term mitigation: lowering batch size and enabling fallback route. We'll schedule enablement + guided runbook. ETA 24 hrs." Anyone edit?

olivia_csm: +1. I'll propose times: 9am or 10am PT. Also want a pre-call checklist: customer workspace config, sample failing payloads, account owner on call.

chao_se: canary deployed to dedicated pool (sha: af3b2c). Patch adjusts batching config. Patch link: https://redwood.internal/changes/af3b2c

raj_support: confirmed reduced error rate in sandbox after patch. Still seeing slower tails for very long inputs. Repro attached.

emma_cs: Action items: 1) chao - monitor canary + rollback criteria (error rate >1% or latency tail >2s), 2) olivia - schedule enablement + send pre-call checklist, 3) jordan/raj - collect failing payload samples and token counts, 4) emma - draft customer comms and renewal ops note. I'll own communications with AE.

mika_pm: Approved. Add renewal extension offer if outage >24h? Recommend 2 weeks trial extension and credit rollover. @legal FYI.

legal_bot: Noted. Please submit PR for credit terms if escalation triggers.

emma_cs: I'll send comms in 30 mins. ETA: final comms + calendar invite by 18:00 UTC. :thumbsup:

olivia_csm: thanks team. keeping customer in the loop with interim note.

jordan_support: thanks all — tagging this P1 -> CS Hand-off. Thread end.
